'''Grish B'reen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chistori]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Soon after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Grish was hired by the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[X-7]] to hunt down and kill [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] as part of a mercenary group led by [[Lune Oddo Divinian]]. Like most Chistori, B'reen was quick to anger and made no attempt to mask his disdain for [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. B'reen's last-known [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was a [[Preybird-class starfighter|Preybird]], which was disabled and claimed by the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] due to a high-tech [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] security device. B'reen, along with most of Divinian's squad, fell victim to the Imperial [[Kaminoan "super-weapon" project|"super-weapon"]] experiment on Kamino.<ref name="Rebel Force: Firefight">''[[Rebel Force: Firefight]]''</ref>
